newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down on initial high selling.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down on initial high selling.

text.p: Tin price ended four cents lower at 15.13 ringgit ($6.06) a kg because of initial high selling interest, traders said.
"Local prices are falling because of an initial high offering," a trader said but added that there were some buying at lower levels due to the local price discount over London.

The Malaysian market was at a $15 a tonne discount over London, against a premium of $5 on Tuesday. Turnover was 128 tonnes against 123 yesterday. Prices are expected to drift at around current levels and dealers said the market trend also depend on London.--Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911)($1=2.4975 rgt)
